items.title: Two wounded in Baghdad grenade attack
items.desc: Shafaq News- Baghdad A hand grenade attack on the Al-Farouq Company for Pipe Casting in western Baghdad injured two people, a security source told Shafaq News on Monday. The incident occurred at the company’s facility in the Ghazaliya area, where two unidentified individuals entered the premises and threw a hand grenade. Company security personnel opened fire as the attackers fled the scene.
